text: Cognitive training has the potential to reduce symptoms of Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD), but its effects on memory dysfunctions related to the disorder remain unclear. Goal of this study was to examine if a computer-based neurocognitive training (c-bnt) improves verbal and visuospatial long-term memory and reduces PTSD and depressive symptoms in active soldiers with PTSD.
source_label: Combining trauma therapy with computer-based neurocognitive training in soldiers with post-traumatic stress disorder: a quasi-experimental study on symptom reduction and long-term memory functions
